application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a single storey front/side infill extension and the erection of a new boundary wall and paving the driveway of the existing house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement, Fire Statement and unnumbered location plan- received 05/01/2022
133/2 and 133/3- received 01/02/2022
1/133- received 27/01/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - Railings for the front garden hereby permitted shall have minimum 100mm gap in between, shall not have any solid background and shall be painted in black at all times.
Condition : 6 - The front garden area shall be surfaced and drainage provision shall be provided within the site to ensure there would be no run-off water from the site into the highway.
